descriptionByHp.text: Dor Ben Dor - HP 100, ATK 5. The final boss of Tiltan | Seems like trying to spare him is a waste of time.

actOptions.description: You talk with Dor Ben Dor about an RPG.
extraMessages: He starts to get excited.|RPGs are one of his favourite generes.
actOptions.speech: RPGs were the cornerstone of humanity when it came to designing games.|Why, I used to roleplay a pacifist monk in World of Warcraft.

actOptions.description: You talk with Dor Ben Dor about RTS.
extraMessages: He starts to get excited.|RTSs are one of his favourite generes.
actOptions.speech: The world doesn't make any more quality RTS games.|They are the most significant part of game design when it comes to innovating strategy games|Why doesn't cloverbite have an RTS game in development?.
